incidents.title: Karmelo Anthony Trial — Defense Opens (Day 4)
incidents.location: Collin County Courthouse, McKinney TX (~200 mi NE) / Austin monitor
incidents.detail: Defense begins presenting its case Monday 9 AM after prosecution rested Saturday following 21 witnesses. Defense argument centers on self-defense: Anthony's team will argue Metcalf was the aggressor and that Frisco ISD had no policy barring athletes from other teams' tents. Key defense moves expected: (1) challenge credibility of teen witnesses, (2) present SRO bodycam in full context, (3) humanize Anthony. All-white jury controversy continues — social media polarization at peak. Multiple civil rights groups calling for mistrial on jury composition grounds. Legal analysts say full acquittal unlikely; manslaughter conviction or hung jury most probable outcomes. Austin protest watch: monitor Capitol/Congress Ave corridor and social media for mobilization tied to verdict. Trial expected to continue through ~June 16–20.

civil_unrest.title: Karmelo Anthony Trial — Defense Phase; Austin Protest Watch Active
civil_unrest.detail: As defense opens, social media activity around Austin-area demonstration planning is at its highest point since trial began. Civil rights groups have publicly criticized the all-white jury selection. Defense argument (self-defense) likely to inflame both sides of the debate simultaneously. Verdict-reactive protest planning observed across multiple platforms targeting Austin. Monitor UT campus, Capitol grounds, and Congress Ave corridor. No confirmed permitted march for today but spontaneous gathering risk elevated during and after major trial developments.

civil_unrest.title: FIFA WC — Iranian Diaspora Protest (Los Angeles)
civil_unrest.detail: 200+ Iranian diaspora protesters gathered outside LA Stadium Sunday ahead of Iran's first WC match (June 15 vs. New Zealand). Protesters waved pre-revolutionary 'Lion and Sun' flags; FIFA reportedly considering banning the flag inside venues. Separate geopolitical context: Israel confirmed strikes on Iranian 'defense systems.' No Austin nexus but signals protest activity pattern will intensify as WC progresses. Elevates baseline threat posture for any Iran-related community events locally.
